svg.title: The lore: AI history in twelve pixel icons
svg.desc: A timeline of framed pixel icons with years: 1950 a teletype (Turing), 1956 a sun (one summer), 1966 a terminal (ELIZA), 1974 a snowflake (AI winter), 1997 a chess knight (Deep Blue), 2012 a cat (the cat paper), 2016 go stones (move 37), 2017 an eye (attention), 2022 a chat bubble, 2024 a pizza slice dripping glue, 2025 headphones (vibes), and 2026 Pix: you are here.
